title: Italian Lamb Stew with Berbere
description: A hearty Italian lamb stew featuring the bold flavors of berbere spice and the comfort of a rich, herbal broth.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the berbere spice and cook for 1 minute.
Add the red wine and cook until reduced by half, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Return the lamb to the pot and reduce heat to low.
Simmer, covered, until the lamb is tender, about 1 1/2 hours.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Stir in chopped parsley and serve hot.
